description: Use this only for flexible-date browsing at a visible Total Parks-listed property or room/site, such as which nearby dates look open or showing availability across a range. Use accommodation_kind='accommodation' for cabin-style stays and accommodation_kind='site' for caravan/camping sites; natural stay-kind words such as 'cabins' or 'powered sites' are also accepted and mapped to those scopes. Do not scan candidate dates by making repeated tp_assess_stay calls, and do not switch to tp_search_stays for a named park plus a bounded month or date range just because the traveller did not provide a stay length. Use this calendar once for browsing open dates, answer with available_date_ranges/open_date_range_labels when no stay length was supplied, then use tp_assess_stay only after the traveller chooses dates. Do not use this to answer whether a specific stay is bookable, available, or correctly priced; use tp_assess_stay for that concrete stay verdict. Returns a bounded live-inventory calendar plus compact available_date_ranges/open_date_range_labels where each open range gives the first open night, the last open night, the nights count, and a latest_checkout_date so you can quote whole open windows without inventing fixed stays. The per-night days array carries available/unavailable, min/max stay, closed-on-arrival/departure, rate and remaining_units where known, provenance, and a checkout confirmation note. Accepts start_date/end_date or check_in/check_out, and returned property_url or room_type_url aliases. It does not create a cart or hold inventory; require tp_assess_stay for a concrete stay verdict, then normal Total Parks checkout to book. Keep the next step on Total Parks URLs rather than park contact.

accommodation_kind.description: Stay-kind filter: 'site' for caravan/camping sites, 'accommodation' for cabins and other roofed stays. Natural words such as 'cabins' or 'powered sites' are also accepted.

adults.description: Number of adults in the party. Default 2. Example: 2.

check_in.description: Stay check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pair with check_out. Example: '2026-10-03'.

check_out.description: Stay check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be after check_in. Example: '2026-10-06'.

children.description: Number of children in the party, excluding infants. Default 0.

end_date.description: Alias of check_out/end. Exclusive or last date depending on the tool; pair with start/start_date. Example: '2026-10-06'.

equipment_length.description: Alias of equipment_length_m. Rig length in metres. Example: 7.5.

equipment_length_m.description: Rig length in metres. Canonical name; aliases equipment_length and length_m are also accepted. Example: 7.5.

equipment_type.description: Canonical rig type such as caravan, camper, motorhome, or tent. Example: 'caravan'.

equipment_width.description: Alias of equipment_width_m. Rig width in metres. Example: 2.5.

equipment_width_m.description: Optional rig width in metres. Canonical name; aliases equipment_width and width_m are also accepted. Example: 2.5.

infants.description: Number of infants in the party. Default 0.

length_m.description: Alias of equipment_length_m. Rig length in metres. Example: 7.5.

property_id.description: Internal property ID. Compatibility only; prefer property_ref or property_url from a previous Total Parks tool result.

property_ref.description: Public property ref from tp_resolve_property or search, formatted as '{state}/{slug}'. Prefer this or property_url over internal IDs. Example: 'victoria/big4-aireys-inlet'.

property_url.description: Traveller-facing Total Parks property URL returned by a previous tool. Accepted as an alias of property_ref. Example: 'https://totalparks.com.au/victoria/big4-aireys-inlet'.

room_type_id.description: Internal room/site type ID. Compatibility only; prefer room_type_ref or room_type_url from a previous tool result.

room_type_ref.description: Public room/site ref returned by search or tp_assess_stay. Example: 'victoria/big4-aireys-inlet/rooms/cosy-cottage-4-person'.

room_type_url.description: Traveller-facing Total Parks room/site URL returned by a previous tool. Accepted as an alias of room_type_ref.

start_date.description: Alias of check_in/start. Inclusive first date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: '2026-10-03'.

width_m.description: Alias of equipment_width_m. Rig width in metres. Example: 2.5.

name: tp_get_availability_calendar

accommodation_kind.description: Optional calendar scope: site for caravan/camping sites or accommodation for cabins, cottages, villas, and other roofed stays.

checkout_note.default: Availability and rates from Total Parks live inventory, kept current by park PMS sync. Confirmed at checkout before payment.

days.description: Per-night detail rows. Each entry is one open or closed night with rate, remaining_units, and stay restrictions; the summary already collapses the open nights into ranges.

remaining_units.description: Remaining bookable units for this day from Total Parks live inventory after public availability filters. Scarcity is a signal, not a hold — complete booking on Total Parks to reserve.

planning_tier_caveat.default: Availability and rates from Total Parks live inventory, kept current by park PMS sync. Confirmed at checkout before payment.

tool_hint.description: Optional MCP tool name that should usually precede this CTA.
Optional MCP tool name that should usually precede this CTA.

items.description: One selectively projected source record for a public claim.

fact_group.description: Decision-critical claim groups eligible for public provenance.

public_source_label.description: Traveller-facing labels approved by the public trust contract.

type.description: Entity or stay window to which the evidence applies.

summary.description: Answer-ready digest. Read this first: open windows live in available_date_ranges/open_date_range_labels with night counts and checkout boundaries, so you rarely need to scan the per-night days array.

answer_hint.default: If the traveller did not provide a stay length, answer with the open date ranges in available_date_ranges/open_date_range_labels. Each range lists its first and last open night plus a latest_checkout_date, so quote whole open windows rather than converting them into fixed check-in/check-out stays or assuming weekends. For exact stays, ask for the number of nights and use tp_assess_stay or Total Parks checkout after the traveller chooses dates.
answer_hint.description: Agent-facing rendering guidance for this planning calendar.

available_date_ranges.description: Contiguous runs of days with live inventory availability.

end_date.description: Last open night in this run of dates.

latest_checkout_date.description: Day after end_date: the latest check-out a stay covering this whole run could use. Use it to avoid off-by-one errors when a traveller wants to stay through the final open night.

nights.description: Number of consecutive open nights in this range.

start_date.description: First open night in this run of dates.

low_availability_days.description: Available days with cached remaining units at or below the low-availability threshold.

open_date_range_labels.description: Traveller-facing labels for available_date_ranges. Use these to answer flexible date questions when no exact stay length was supplied, instead of inventing fixed check-in/check-out stays.

tightest_remaining_units.description: Smallest remaining unit count across available calendar days.
